recognize_zh: 胸部 CT 軸切面可見左前上胸壁、胸大肌深層一顆巨大、邊界相對清楚的軟組織腫塊，內部密度偏低、較均質，旁邊另有圓形結節（腋下淋巴結可能）；巨大且快速長大的腫塊符合難治性雙重打擊淋巴瘤（double-hit lymphoma）的臨床脈絡。
features: Axial CT of the upper chest at the level of the aortic arch branches
Very large, lobulated soft-tissue mass in the left anterosuperior chest wall deep to the pectoral muscles
Mass is relatively homogeneous and hypoattenuating relative to muscle, possibly reflecting necrosis
Adjacent rounded soft-tissue nodule(s) toward the left axilla, suggestive of lymphadenopathy
Lungs clear; mediastinal vessels and trachea not displaced in this slice
Non-morphologic image: vascular invasion described clinically cannot be assessed on this single slice
describe_en: Axial CT of the chest shows a very large, lobulated, relatively low-attenuation soft-tissue mass in the left anterosuperior chest wall deep to the pectoral musculature, with an adjacent rounded soft-tissue nodule toward the left axilla. The lungs are clear and the mediastinal structures are not displaced at this level. The low internal attenuation may reflect necrosis, as described clinically; vascular and thyroid invasion reported in the case are outside this slice. The imaging is compatible with bulky, aggressive lymphoma in a patient with refractory high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements, but diagnosis rests on histology and FISH.

ddx.dx: Soft-tissue sarcoma of the chest wall
ddx.vs: Sarcoma is separated by biopsy showing spindle or pleomorphic mesenchymal cells negative for CD45 and B-cell markers.
An abscess usually shows a thick enhancing rim with central fluid attenuation and gas or fat stranding, and aspiration yields neutrophils and organisms rather than sheets of large lymphoid cells.
Carcinoma is distinguished on biopsy by cohesive cytokeratin-positive cells lacking CD20/CD45.
